power.answer: No United page with a power bank rule could be read, so this page uses the US aviation regulator: spare lithium batteries and power banks go in carry-on only, up to 100 Wh each with no federal count limit, and 101 to 160 Wh needs airline approval with two at most. From 27 March 2026 the international standard also limits power banks to two per passenger with no recharging in flight. Check United before you fly.

faq: Can I check a power bank on United?
No. The FAA says spare lithium batteries and power banks must be in carry-on baggage only.
How many power banks can I carry on United?
The FAA sets no count limit for batteries up to 100 Wh, but ICAO's 2026 standard limits passengers to two power banks, and United may be stricter.
